name: Plainstrider Meat
summary: Across Red Cloud Mesa, Plainstrider Meat helps feed Camp Narache. Young tauren hunt the birds for food and feathers, proving their skill and self-reliance.

sections.title: Sustenance for the Mesa
sections.body: Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa depends on game from the surrounding grasslands. Plainstrider meat helps feed the village when food stocks run low. The birds also provide feathers for clothing and ceremonial adornments. Tauren life depends on the land, and survival means taking what is needed while respecting nature.

sections.title: A Young Hunter's Trial
sections.body: Grull Hawkwind sends young hunters across Red Cloud Mesa to track the swift plainstriders. They gather meat and feathers to prove their tracking skill and self-reliance. Then they appear before Grull's father, Chief Hawkwind.

faq.q: What is Plainstrider Meat used for?
aliases: what do i do with plainstrider meat
faq.answer: Young hunters gather Plainstrider Meat on Red Cloud Mesa to replenish Camp Narache's food stores for Grull Hawkwind.
Grull Hawkwind asks young hunters to hunt plainstriders and replenish the tribe's food supplies while proving their worth as providers.

faq.q: Where can Plainstrider Meat be found?
faq.answer: Plainstriders roam Mulgore's grasslands, including Red Cloud Mesa, where their meat is gathered.

faq.q: Why is hunting plainstriders considered important to the tauren?
faq.answer: Tauren hunt plainstriders for food and as a spiritual discipline. Bringing game to camp shows respect for the Earth Mother, self-reliance, and the ability to sustain the tribe.

angles.text: As a tauren youth on Red Cloud Mesa, hunting plainstriders is an early step toward earning Chief Hawkwind's respect and the right to walk into Thunder Bluff.
As a hunter, you can test your tracking and marksmanship against swift plainstriders across Mulgore's open plains.
